Subject: Offer packet review: Evan Brooks (Sr. ModelOps) — comp & band confirmation

Team,

Quick summary: Evan Brooks (final loop completed last week) is our top choice for Senior ModelOps Engineer (reports to Markus). We recommend an IC4 leveling with a base salary at the top of band (US-SF market), a 12% target bonus, and 0.20% equity (4-year vesting, 1-year cliff). Evan has two competing offers; timing is tight.

Asks:
- Can we sign off on the comp band + exception to allow base at band max? (We would need an exception to the payband floor for IC4.)
- Confirm equity recommendation above — Marissa, can you confirm available equity refresh slot?
- Lauren, if you OK the exception, I need final signoff to route the offer via DocuSign by EOD Friday.

Attachments: evan_brooks_offer_packet.pdf (offer terms + resume), comp_band_workbook.xlsx (calcs), offer_text_draft_v3.docx

Notes: I added a short justification memo in the workbook — background (strong inference runtime experience, shipped KV-cache optimizations at scale). Candidate requests a start window of Jul 12–26.

Thanks — please reply with clear Approve/Revise.

Best,
Karthik

> Team,
> 
> Quick summary: Evan Brooks ...

Thanks Karthik — looks clean. Two quick clarifying items before I can confirm equity:
- Is the 0.20% total grant from the current equity pool, or a top-up from the senior candidate reserve? Need to know for Q2 reporting.
- Any relocation/temporary housing budget needed? Candidate flagged possible relocation from Austin to SF; mentioned 2–3 weeks for family overlap.

If equity comes from reserve we can do the 0.20% as requested. For relocation, we typically approve up to $8k for a move within the US; if Evan needs more, bring it back to me.

Markus — curious whether you want to recommend a sign-on bonus in lieu of a larger base adjustment? That might be an easier exception to greenlight.

Marissa

On Wed, May 26, 2027 at 9:02 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Karthik — looks clean. Two quick clarifying items...

Agree with Marissa — equity from the senior reserve is fine. I don’t anticipate a relocation >$8k; Evan said spouse will stay in Austin for the summer and he’ll do an initial commute.

Rationale for band-exception: Evan’s recent role had direct ownership of inference runtime perf for sub-20ms 2k-token tails (public benchmark). He’s also got relevant infra partnerships (NVIDIA + Ampere tuned kernels) that will accelerate our latency roadmap. Given urgency (competing offers) I support moving base to band max with a $10k sign-on to smooth comp parity.

Approve: Band exception to allow base at band max (IC4).
Recommend: Approve 0.20% from senior reserve + $10,000 sign-on.

Please route to Lauren for final exec approval — if Lauren OKs, we’ll push the DocuSign envelope and loop Chad/evan for signature.

-Markus
